phases.title: Phase 1: Discovery
phases.strategy:
This app has not been assessed yet. A discovery phase is required to build a baseline before the refactor plan can be written.

Discovery checklist:
- Schedule discovery workshop with SMEs
- Run full vulnerability scan (parity with other apps)
- Confirm external integration sandbox availability
- Produce a phase-assignment proposal

Known blockers:
- External integration has no known test/sandbox environment
- SMEs for the legacy document pipeline are scattered across teams
phases.rollback: Discovery phases are non-destructive. If scope changes during discovery, update the decision file and re-run the planner.

narrative: **Pre-assigned decision: TBD** (phase TBD). Rationale: Not analyzed by the vendor Report Out. No Kardex report, no code findings summary, no cyclomatic complexity data. A discovery workshop is required to establish a baseline before the refactor plan can be written. The app-04 application contains 5 modules (3,139 lines of code, 106 known vulnerabilities). NexusForge proposes a 1-phase strangler decomposition covering discovery. Total estimated effort: 8 engineer-days (~1 working weeks for a single engineer, or ~1 weeks for a 4-engineer team working in parallel). Each phase is independently deployable and reversible — no big-bang cut-over.
